title: Terra Exploration Group survey finds tunnel from Secret Mountain to Clarkdale Cement Plant
place_text: Secret Mountain to Bradshaw Ranch to Clarkdale Cement Plant, Arizona

tellings.quote: A tunnel. Geophysical surveys and magnetometry by Terra Exploration Group showed a straight, man-made tunnel, roughly 50 ft in diameter, running like a hidden artery from Secret Mountain to Bradshaw Ranch to the front gate of the Clarkdale Cement Plant, which John Bradshaw claims used to be the biggest employer in town, and was guarded and [music] fenced like a military site.

plain: Michels says that a firm called Terra Exploration Group used ground surveys and magnetometry, which measures the magnetic field to spot what lies buried, and found a straight, man-made tunnel about 50 feet wide in Arizona. In his telling, it runs like a hidden artery from Secret Mountain to Bradshaw Ranch to the front gate of the Clarkdale Cement Plant, which a man named John Bradshaw claims was once the town's biggest employer and was guarded and fenced like a military site. Michels narrates this himself in a 2026 episode, and it would point to a secret underground facility hidden behind an ordinary business.
